scope: Ideal liquid properties, component transport, regular-grid reacting feedback, representative breakup/splitting, composition-inheriting KH shed children, boundary budgets, composition checkpoints and shared-composition CLI/injection.
boundary: No excess mixing energy, mixture wall impact, per-port mixture compositions or component property-fit CLI inputs yet. Uses PeleF carrier molecular weight, binary harmonic diffusion and existing heat-transfer convention rather than full upstream coefficient parity.
rate_rule: Effective D=sum(X_surface_i*D_i)/sum(X_surface_i); component share=X_surface_i*D_i/sum(X_surface_j*D_j), common Stefan transfer with existing selectable Ranz-Marshall/Abramzon-Sirignano correlations.

terminal_policy.rule: Actively evaporating trace/residual component mass is transferred to gas; predicted diameter below configured minimum transfers the whole droplet. Suppressed components are retained unless the complete droplet reaches the diameter cutoff.
terminal_policy.difference: Pinned Drag.H zeroes trace fractions and renormalizes. PeleF explicitly returns residual mass and energy to gas.
